about: Call copilot script (team B2, 2026-11-14): the words for a HUMAN caller. The slots in curly braces are filled from the lead, your settings and the trade (callcore.js fill() / agency/calls/core.py fill()); a slot with no value gets a plain fallback, never a blank or a brace. Honest by design: say who you are and that it is a sales call, never invent clients, reviews or results, stop at once when asked.
opener: Hi, {contactAsk} This is {me} with {myBiz}, a small web studio in {myCity}. It is a sales call, so I will be quick: I build websites for {plural}, and I already made a free preview of a new site for {biz}. Can I take 30 seconds to tell you why?
why: Thanks. I called because {issue}. The preview fixes that: {hook}.
questions: How do most new customers find {biz} right now: Google, word of mouth, or social media?
When someone finds you on their phone, what do you want them to do: {ask}?
If the new site brought you {goal}, would it be worth 10 minutes to look at the preview together?
close: Great. Can I send you the link so you can look at it today? Is a text or an email better for you?
consent: So it is OK if I text the link to this number? (They said yes: tap 'They said I can text'.)
book: When could we look at it together for 10 minutes: {day} at 10, or {day} at 2?

objections.title: I already have a site
lines: That is great, most of my clients had one too.
Quick question: when did you last open it on your phone?
I made the preview because {issue}. Let me send you both side by side: if yours is better, you lost one minute.

objections.title: Too expensive
lines: Fair question. What did you expect a website to cost?
{priceLine}
You can look at the preview first and decide after. There is no contract to see it.

objections.title: Not interested
lines: No problem. Can I ask one thing: is it the timing, or are you happy with how customers find you now?
If it is the timing: can I send you the preview so you have it when you are ready?
Still no: thank them and tap Not interested. If they say 'do not call me', tap Do not call.

objections.title: Send me an email
lines: Happy to. What is the best email for you?
I will send the preview link and three lines, no attachments.
When can I call to hear what you think: {day} afternoon?

objections.title: Who are you with?
lines: Yes, it is a sales call, I will be honest. I am {me}, I run {myBiz}, a small web studio in {myCity}.
I build websites for {plural}. I am not a big agency and I am not selling ads or long contracts.
I made the preview for {biz} before I called, so you can see exactly what you would get.

objections.title: Front desk (gatekeeper)
lines: Hi, this is {me} with {myBiz}. Who looks after your website?
Could you tell me the best time to reach {contactOrOwner}?
Could you pass on a message? I made a free preview of a new site for {biz}. What is the best email to send it to?

objections.title: How did you get my number?
lines: From your business listing online ({source}). I only call businesses, about their website.
If you would rather I did not call this number, I will take it off my list right now.

objections.title: Take me off your list
lines: Of course. I have taken your number off my list: you will not hear from me again. Have a good day.
Then tap Do not call. Never argue, never call back.

voicemail.vm1: Hi {contactName}, this is {me} with {myBiz} in {myCity}. I made a free preview of a new website for {biz}, and I think you will like it. You can call or text me back at {myPhone}, that is {myPhone}. I will also try you again {day}. Thanks, have a great day.
voicemail.vm2: Hi {contactName}, it is {me} again from {myBiz}, about the free website preview for {biz}. If now is not the time, no problem at all. My number is {myPhone}. Thanks!
voicemail.rule: Leave it live, in your own voice, under 25 seconds. Never a recorded, AI or 'ringless' voicemail drop: those need written consent.

e1.subject: Preview of a new website for {biz}

e2.subject: 3 quick fixes for the {biz} website

e3.subject: Quick question about {biz}

e4.subject: Should I close your file?

texts.t1: Hi {contactName}, it is {me} from {myBiz}. Here is the preview of the new {biz} site you asked for: {demoOrOffer}
texts.t2: Hi {contactName}, {me} from {myBiz} here. Did you get a chance to look at the website preview? Happy to change anything: {demoOrOffer}

fallback.demoOrOffer: (reply to this and I will send you the link)
fallback.priceLine: It costs less than what one new customer a month brings you.
